evaluation.rationale: The notes capture a large amount of the transcript's information but suffer from severe structural and conciseness issues. The same facts are repeated across a dozen redundant sections (Overview, Summary, Progress, Decisions, Blockers, Dependencies, Follow-up, Action Items, Risks, etc.), making the document extremely dense and hard to read. There are critical errors, such as listing superseded values (10% rollout, October 6 launch date) as final decisions and action items. The notes also hallucinate action items (e.g., Ines mocking up a middle option) and misattribute QA's concerns to the front-end team. Several deadlines and specific action item owners are missing.
